integrity: The four local cases were reconstructed from the full text of arXiv:2609.09937v1, including Lemma 2.1 and the explicit four- and five-fiber statements. The global count is obtained by summing over disjoint target rectangles and checking that the product/projection gluing adds no codimension-two event. The parity statement is proved separately from the braid permutation.
scientific_limitations: The formula counts codimension-two fibers in Kato's specific prescribed-indefinite-fold construction. It is not a link invariant and does not prove minimality over all stable maps. The exact count depends on the chosen compressed braid representative and its distinguished Artin generator.
title: A \(0/1/\ge4\) codimension-two gap in Kato's prescribed-indefinite-fold construction
